meta.name: cs-customer-escalation
meta.description: Empacota uma escalação para Devs, Produto ou Davidson com contexto completo. Use quando um bug precisa de atenção além do suporte normal, vários clientes reportam o mesmo problema, um cliente está ameaçando cancelar, ou um problema ficou sem resolução além do SLA. / Package an escalation for engineering, product, or leadership with full context. Use when a bug needs engineering attention beyond normal support, multiple customers report the same issue, a customer is threatening to churn, or an issue has sat unresolved past its SLA.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将客户升级问题打包给相关团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将客户问题升级给工程或产品团队
copy.tagline_en: Package customer escalations for engineering or product teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to escalate customer issues to engineering or product teams

howto.what: 当用户请求升级支持问题时，Claude 会自动收集问题上下文、评估业务影响、确定升级目标（工程、产品、领导层），并生成结构化的升级简报。
howto.when: 当用户描述的问题符合以下任一条件：bug 需要工程关注、多个客户报告同一问题、客户威胁取消、问题超过 SLA 未解决。

say.text: 将 Acme 公司的间歇性 500 错误升级到工程团队。
say.note: 触发升级流程，生成简报。

say.text: 汇总近一周内三个客户报告的数据导出缺失问题，向产品组升级。

howto.what_en: When a user requests to escalate a support issue, Claude automatically gathers context, assesses business impact, determines the escalation target (engineering, product, leadership), and generates a structured escalation brief.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user describes an issue matching: a bug needing engineering attention, multiple customers reporting same issue, customer threatening churn, or issue past SLA.

say_en.text: Escalate Acme's intermittent 500 errors to engineering.
Summarize 3 customers' data export bugs this week for product.
